findings.subject: report sec 3.1 (criterion a) — upwind viscosity table
findings.claim_as_written: 9 per-row measured nu and a relative-error column (0.03%-0.50%) show |nu_meas/nu_th - 1| < 1%

evidence_locator.quote: **结论**: ✅ 全部 9 组合误差 < 1%，最大误差 0.50%

reviewer_recomputation.method: independent 1D periodic upwind solver + single-mode amplitude decay, 2 wave periods, k dx = 2 pi m/256

findings.impact: the acceptance conclusion survives (reviewer max deviation 0.16% < 1%), but 9 of 9 stated per-row numbers are not reproducible and 3 of 9 have the wrong sign of deviation, so the table cannot serve as evidence for the criteria it is attached to

candidate_mechanism_hypothesis.status: unverified_hypothesis (producer code not in review scope)
candidate_mechanism_hypothesis.text: a nu that is biased by (k_used/k_true)^2 (rounded k dx in the denominator) or by a time base that is not an integer number of steps would produce exactly this kind of few-tenths-of-a-percent offset; the review asserts only that the printed values are not obtainable from the stated parameters, not why

findings.disposition: needs-fix: replace the measured column with values recomputed from the exact symbol (or publish the solver + seed so the residual round-off is reproducible); do not widen the criterion to make the numbers fit

findings.subject: report sec 2.2 / 1.2 — QUICK leading-order viscosity formula and its 'small but nonzero' characterisation
findings.claim_as_written: QUICK: nu_th = c dx (1-C)(1-C^2)/8, described as '二阶迎风型，小但非零的数值黏性'

reviewer_recomputation.derivation: Fourier substitution of the Leonard two-upstream interpolation u_{j+1/2} = 3/4 u_j + 3/8 u_{j-1} - 1/8 u_{j-2} gives nu -> c dx (5-4C)/8 as k dx -> 0

findings.impact: the printed QUICK coefficient is 5.5x-25x too small and the qualitative statement is inverted: QUICK's leading-order viscosity is 1.3x-2.25x that of first-order upwind at the same Courant number, not smaller. The report gives no QUICK stencil, so the formula cannot even be checked against its own scheme
findings.disposition: needs-fix: either print the QUICK stencil next to the formula, or drop the analytic QUICK row and keep QUICK as explicitly qualitative

findings.subject: report sec 3.3 (criterion c) — Lax-Wendroff residual viscosity
findings.claim_as_written: nu_meas = 1.2e-4 ... 7.2e-4, 'nu_num 比阈值小 1-2 个量级'

evidence_locator.quote: **结论**: ✅ ν_num 比阈值小 1-2 个量级，相位误差全部 < 1%

reviewer_recomputation.theta_scaling_report: reported nu doubles when kdx doubles -> O(theta)
reviewer_recomputation.C_dependence_theory: C(1-C^2)/8 peaks at C=1/sqrt(3)=0.5774; report rises monotonically

findings.impact: the pass/fail conclusion (nu << 1e-2 c dx) survives with a 5.6x margin, not the ~14x the table implies; the tabulated values are off by 0.33x-2.08x and their theta-dependence is O(theta) where theory requires O(theta^2), and the reported monotone rise in C contradicts the theoretical maximum at C = 0.577

candidate_mechanism_hypothesis.text: the reported O(theta) scaling is what a fixed step count (rather than a fixed number of wave periods) would give; recorded as a hypothesis only

findings.disposition: needs-fix: recompute the column from the Lax-Wendroff symbol; the 1-2 orders-of-magnitude margin claim must be re-derived before it is restated

findings.subject: report sec 2.3 / 3.2 (criterion b) — von Neumann amplification factor
findings.claim_as_written: criterion |G_num - G_ana| < 1e-3 (sec 2.3, absolute) and |G_num - G_ana|/|G_ana| < 1e-3 (sec 3.2, relative), residual column 1.5e-4-5.9e-4

ill_posed_case.why: upwind |G(pi)| = |1-2C| = 0 at C=0.5, so the relative criterion divides by 0

findings.impact: two incompatible thresholds are stated for one criterion; the relative form divides by |G| = 0 at upwind C = 0.5, theta = pi; an independent march agrees with the closed form at 1e-15, i.e. 11 orders below the tabulated residuals, and a 0.1% coefficient error still passes the absolute form at C = 0.2 and C = 0.5 -> the criterion as written cannot detect the defect it exists to detect, and the tabulated residual column has no traceable provenance
findings.disposition: needs-fix: fix one definition (absolute on a normalised G), exclude theta where |G|->0, and add a mutant/negative control so the threshold has demonstrated sensitivity

findings.subject: report sec 3.4 (criterion d) — CD2 amplitude growth band
findings.impact: |G|=1.118 (C=0.5) and 1.281 (C=0.8) at theta=pi/2 are reproduced exactly, but the quoted growth band holds for 2 of 9 cases: the reviewer range is 1.016-1.272, so 7 of 9 cases grow far less than the '15%' lower bound. The qualitative conclusion (CD2 is dispersive and unstable) holds
findings.disposition: needs-fix: quote the growth per case (or the range over the tested C, k dx pairs) instead of a band that no enumerated case supports

findings.subject: report sec 3.5 (criterion e) — grid convergence table

evidence_locator.quote: **结论**: ✅ ν_num 严格随 Δx 线性衰减，比值 0.500 ± 0.001

reviewer_recomputation.assumed_parameters: C = 0.5, physical mode m = 8 on domain L = 256 (report states neither C nor k dx per level)

findings.impact: conclusion (nu proportional to dx) reproduced: ratios 0.4994-0.49996 vs the stated 0.500-0.501, deviation 0.12% against a 5% tolerance. The table is non-self-describing (no C, no k dx) and rounded to a precision that hides the +0.16% finite-theta deviation visible in sec 3.1
findings.disposition: approve with notes: add the per-level (C, k dx) columns
